The '''Vunakia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> as a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] region.<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the group known as [[Vunakian]]s, whose membership included the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] [[Kohn Doil]].<ref name="MS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vunakia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square S-7.<ref name="TEA" />
